description: This file contains the definition of the InventoryServices class, which provides various static methods for managing inventory operations such as preparing and completing inventory transfers, cancelling transfers, checking inventory availability, and retrieving inventory summaries for products and facilities within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: InventoryServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for inventory management operations within OFBiz, including transfer preparation/completion, cancellation, availability checks, and inventory summaries.

methods.name: prepareInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Prepares an inventory transfer by creating or updating inventory items and adjusting their details based on transfer quantity and type.

methods.name: completeInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Completes an inventory transfer, updating inventory items and transfer status, and handling serialized/non-serialized item specifics.

methods.name: cancelInventoryTransfer
methods.description: Cancels an inventory transfer and reverts inventory item statuses and quantities accordingly.

methods.name: checkInventoryAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of inventory and back-ordered items, sending notifications or cancelations as needed.

methods.name: getProductInventoryAvailableFromAssocProducts
methods.description: Calculates the combined inventory availability based on associated products, considering their quantities and available inventories.

methods.name: getProductInventorySummaryForItems
methods.description: Provides a summary of inventory and pricing details for given order items, across multiple facilities.

methods.name: getProductInventoryAndFacilitySummary
methods.description: Retrieves inventory quantities, prices, and usage statistics for a specific product at a given facility.
